name: Robot Framework
tools: Python 3.12 or later with pip and venv
VS Code with the RobotCode extension
Git with GitHub Actions or Jenkins

beginner.summary: For manual testers, junior automation engineers and developers who are new to Robot Framework. Covers installation with Python and pip, suite file structure, library and user keywords, standard libraries, variables, resource files, control structures, tags, setups and teardowns, web testing with the Browser library compared with SeleniumLibrary, locators, waits, logs and reports, the robot command, data-driven and behaviour-driven styles, and preparation for the RFCP exam.
prerequisites: Uses a terminal on Windows, macOS or Linux and can edit text files
Knows basic test design: test cases, expected results and defect reports
Laptop with Python 3.12 or later, VS Code and permission to install pip packages
outcomes: Write and run Robot Framework suites with library keywords, user keywords, variables and resource files
Automate web tests with the Browser library and explain when SeleniumLibrary is the better fit
Select, tag and rerun tests from the command line and find the cause of failures in log.html
Sit the RFCP exam with practised knowledge of every syllabus chapter
